# Trim

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Strings](Language-Features-Strings)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Trim:String string:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | In | String | required | The text. |

**Returns:** The text without the blanks at its ends.

## Description

Removes spaces, tabs and other invisible characters from both ends of a string.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print "[" + Trim$("   hi there  ") + "]"
```

```text
[hi there]
```
